messages:
priya: quick sync — tenant routing pilot launch is Weds. We need to lock scope by EOD. Customer A is pushing for SAML and per-tenant usage quotas. What can we realistically ship in MVP?
sam: perf wise the emb cache and per-tenant routing add complexity. If we keep both, p95 jumps ~40ms on our bench. Can we drop quotas for MVP?
leila: current ops hypothesis: quotas can be soft-limited in console (UI only) and enforced in v1. That would be a config flag, lower risk.
jordan: Customer A flagged compliance reqs for SAML; they said "must have" for pilot but are flexible on timeline if we give a clear tradeoff. They prefer earlier pilot > full SSO.
mike: infra notes: SAML integration touches private deployment docs + KMS onboarding. That's non-trivial for a pilot timeline. Suggest defer SAML to v1.
priya: proposal: MVP includes tenant routing + emb-cache + UI soft-quotas. Defer hard quota enforcement and SAML to v1. Need engineering + security signoff.
sam: OK to drop hard quotas. We should keep emb-cache but with conservative TTL and a hotkey to purge. I'll add a flag: `--emb-cache-mode=conservative`.
alex: can we define launch acceptance criteria? simple list helps sales/customer commit.
leila: acceptance criteria draft: 1) routing works for N tenants concurrently (N=50), 2) p95 latency within 300ms under pilot load, 3) console shows quota UI, 4) audit logs enabled, 5) documented fallback if emb-cache misbehaves.
jordan: Customer A will accept if we promise SAML + hard quotas in v1 with a migration path. I'll capture that in the pilot contract.
sam: small ops ask: add a canary flag to route 10% traffic to dedicated pool for first 24h. If metrics cross thresholds, auto-fallback to hosted model.
priya: agree. Add canary + automatic fallback to acceptance. Also add regression test for per-tenant isolation.
mike: security signoff: SAML defer OK but must ensure no secrets leak between tenants. I'll run a quick threat model and sign off by EOD.
alex: timeline reset check — with these cuts we can keep Weds launch. If any signoff misses EOD we slip to next Tue.
leila: ops checklist: run smoke, canary, migrate metrics dashboards, update runbooks. I'll own runbooks.
priya: final call: cutlist = defer SAML, defer hard quota enforcement, keep emb-cache conservative, add UI-only quota, add canary route + fallback. Accept?
jordan: +1 from CS side.
sam: +1 engineering.
mike: +1 security (pending final threat model doc).
alex: I'll update the roadmap doc and notify sales.
deploy-bot: Reminder — changing rollout flags requires a canary job. Triggering job: `canary:start --route tenant-pilot --percent 10`
